blocks.label: Suggested use

paragraphs: Sodium Palmate, Sodium Cocoate* or Sodium Palm Kernelate, Water (Aqua), Glycerin, Eucalyptus (Eucalyptus globulus) Leaf Oil, Kaolin, Sodium Chloride, Sodium Gluconate, Tetrasodium Glutamate Diacetate, Peppermint (Mentha piperita) Oil.
Formulated Without: Animal By-Products • Artificial Colors or Fragrances • Gluten • Parabens • Petroleum Derivatives • Phthalates • Sodium Lauryl/Laureth Sulfates

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children.
